# Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of
January 1, 2026 between Acme Corporation and Beta Corporation.

## 1. Definitions

"Confidential Information" means any non-public information disclosed by a party. The
Confidential Information includes business plans and customer lists. Each party shall
protect the Confidential Information as described in Section 2.

## 2. Obligations

Each party shall keep the Confidential Information secret and use it only for the purpose
described in Section 3. Acme Corporation and Beta Corporation agree to handle the
Confidential Information under this Agreement.

## 3. Purpose

The purpose of this Agreement is to evaluate a potential transaction. This Agreement
governs the Confidential Information exchanged by Acme Corporation and Beta Corporation
for that purpose.

## 4. Term

This Agreement is effective as of January 1, 2026 and expires on January 1, 2028. The
Agreement remains binding on Acme Corporation and Beta Corporation until then.
